texts.preamble: Wajid Ali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 March, 2025 Author: Pranay Verma Bench: Pranay Verma Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:7146 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma On The 18th Of March, 2025 Writ Petition No. 8251 of 2025 Wajid Ali Versus The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
texts.arguments: 02. This petition has been preferred by the petitioner being aggrieved by the order dated 11.02.2025 (Annexure P/3) passed by respondent No.2, the Deputy Director and Authorized Officer, Food Safety and Standards Act, whereby his license for running a meat shop has been cancelled. 03. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the aforesaid order has been passed by respondent No.2 without issuance of any show cause notice to the petitioner, without affording him any opportunity of hearing and in violation of the principles of natural justice. Even as per Rules, an opportunity of hearing ought to have been given to the petitioner. Since the same has not been done, the impugned order deserves to be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. 04. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondents/State has submitted NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:7146 2 WP-8251-2025 that under the Rules, the respondents have the right to cancel license as has been done in the present case without issuance of any show cause notice. It is further submitted that against the impugned order, the petitioner has the remedy of preferring an appeal under the rules itself. The petition hence deserved to be dismissed.
